notes: Only style 3 ships. Styles 1 (since 2003) and 2 (9/30/1998 through 2002) state year = 2nd-3rd positions and month = 4th position but both say 'see chart' for year and month, and the page's own style 1 decodes prove the year is chart-mapped, not direct digits (code 47 = 2003, code 52 = 2012); both styles are chart-only and held for the image pass. Style 3 states year = 2nd-3rd positions with no chart qualifier and month = 4th position (see chart), so it ships year-only with month held.
parent: National Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Products, Inc.

styles.era: Used prior to 9/30/1998; letter + 2 digits + letter + 4 digits
styles.notes: Page example serial B98 B1112. Year digits are the 2nd-3rd characters (1-based page positions converted to 0-based half-open [1,3]); 98 resolves to 1998 under the 1960 floor. Month = 4th position per page text but its mapping lives only in the style 3 chart image, so month is null and the style ships year-only.
